solutionSql: SELECT s.customer_id, ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))::integer AS avg_kg FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.customer_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6 GROUP BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.customer_id;

rules.howSolved: ROUND is applied to the numeric AVG, then cast to integer.

ambiguities: 'rounded to the nearest whole kilogram' does not say how an exact .5 is rounded. PostgreSQL ROUND on numeric rounds half away from zero, which is what I used.

'For customers with ids 1 through 6' does not say whether a customer in that range with no shipments, or with only unweighed shipments, is listed. I grouped over shipments, so a customer with no shipments is not listed. All six customers have shipments in the sample, nulls and ties datasets.
notes: Read-only item. Ran without error on sample, nulls and ties. The mechanics are standard; the uncertainty is the half-kilogram tie rule and the customer-listing wording. Solve time is an estimate.
